events.title: Microsoft turns Copilot into a tenant-governed agent workspace
events.title_zh: Microsoft 把 Copilot 扩展为租户治理的 agent 工作区
events.summary: Microsoft introduced a new Copilot structure around Home, Code and Autopilot. Code builds small apps and automations in a sandbox that can be hosted inside the customer tenant. Copilot Managed Runtime provides IT-governed hosting and is in preview. Autopilot is a persistent cloud agent with its own identity, memory, computer and workspace, but it remains private preview; Home and Code also begin in the Frontier program rather than broad GA.
events.why_it_matters: For enterprise teams, the product boundary is shifting from a chat assistant to a governed execution workspace. Treat this as an architecture signal, not a deployment-ready stack: trial Managed Runtime isolation and spending controls first, and require explicit identity, permissions, audit and human escalation before giving Autopilot recurring work.
events.summary_zh: Microsoft 发布了由 Home、Code 与 Autopilot 组成的新 Copilot。Code 可在沙箱中构建小型应用与自动化，并把运行环境放在客户租户内。Copilot Managed Runtime 提供由 IT 治理的托管能力，目前处于 preview。Autopilot 是持续运行的云端 agent，拥有独立身份、记忆、计算机与工作区，但仍是 private preview；Home 与 Code 也先从 Frontier program 开始，而非全面 GA。
events.summary_en: Microsoft introduced a new Copilot structure around Home, Code and Autopilot. Code builds small apps and automations in a sandbox that can be hosted inside the customer tenant. Copilot Managed Runtime provides IT-governed hosting and is in preview. Autopilot is a persistent cloud agent with its own identity, memory, computer and workspace, but it remains private preview; Home and Code also begin in the Frontier program rather than broad GA.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对企业团队来说，产品边界正从聊天助手转向受治理的执行工作区。现阶段应把它看成架构信号，而不是可直接上线的完整栈：先验证 Managed Runtime 的隔离与花费控制，再为 Autopilot 的周期性任务明确身份、权限、审计和人工升级路径。
events.why_it_matters_en: For enterprise teams, the product boundary is shifting from a chat assistant to a governed execution workspace. Treat this as an architecture signal, not a deployment-ready stack: trial Managed Runtime isolation and spending controls first, and require explicit identity, permissions, audit and human escalation before giving Autopilot recurring work.

events.title: GitHub makes agentic autofix generally available for code scanning
events.title_zh: GitHub 将 code scanning 的 agentic autofix 推向 GA
events.summary: GitHub made agentic autofix generally available for CodeQL alerts. Copilot explores the repository, proposes a fix, reruns CodeQL and iterates before opening a draft pull request. Teams can assign one default-branch alert, up to 25 alerts associated with one pull request, or use the REST API. It requires GitHub Code Security or Advanced Security, administrator enablement and a Copilot billing method; work consumes Code Security AI Credits and GitHub Actions minutes.
events.why_it_matters: For security teams, the workflow now closes the loop from alert to validated draft patch instead of stopping at a suggestion. CodeQL reruns are useful evidence, not a guarantee of semantic correctness, so human review and representative tests remain mandatory.
events.summary_zh: GitHub 将 CodeQL alert 的 agentic autofix 推向 GA。Copilot 会浏览仓库、提出修复、重新运行 CodeQL，再迭代到可打开 draft pull request。团队可以分配一个默认分支 alert、同一 pull request 关联的最多 25 个 alert，或通过 REST API 调用。它需要 GitHub Code Security 或 Advanced Security、管理员启用和 Copilot 计费方式，并消耗 Code Security AI Credits 与 GitHub Actions 分钟。
events.summary_en: GitHub made agentic autofix generally available for CodeQL alerts. Copilot explores the repository, proposes a fix, reruns CodeQL and iterates before opening a draft pull request. Teams can assign one default-branch alert, up to 25 alerts associated with one pull request, or use the REST API. It requires GitHub Code Security or Advanced Security, administrator enablement and a Copilot billing method; work consumes Code Security AI Credits and GitHub Actions minutes.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对安全团队来说，这把流程从“给建议”推进到“生成并用 CodeQL 复查 draft patch”。CodeQL 重跑是有价值的证据，不等于语义正确；人工审查和代表性测试仍不可省。
events.why_it_matters_en: For security teams, the workflow now closes the loop from alert to validated draft patch instead of stopping at a suggestion. CodeQL reruns are useful evidence, not a guarantee of semantic correctness, so human review and representative tests remain mandatory.

evidence.claim_zh: GitHub agentic autofix 现在会在处理安全告警前读取 Copilot Memory，并把成功修复方式保存下来，供后续任务复用。同一份仓库记忆还能提供给 Copilot code review 与 Copilot cloud agent。agentic autofix 和 Copilot Memory 都仍处于 public preview。GitHub 尚未公布引入记忆后的修复成功率或误报数据。
evidence.claim_en: GitHub agentic autofix now reads Copilot Memory before resolving a security alert and stores successful fix patterns for later work. The same repository memory can inform Copilot code review and the Copilot cloud agent. Both agentic autofix and Copilot Memory remain in public preview. GitHub does not publish outcome or false-positive data for the memory-assisted flow.
